text: וְהֵ֖ם אַלְפֵ֥י מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃ {ס} וְלִזְבוּלֻ֣ן אָמַ֔ר

translation:
Rejoice, O Zebulun, on your journeys,
And Issachar, in your tents.
They invite their kin

to the mountain,
Where they offer sacrifices of success.

Gad he said:

off arm and scalp.

chieftain,

he said:
Dan is a lion’s whelp
That leaps forth from Bashan. And of Naphtali he said:
O

Naphtali, sated with favor
And full of יהוה’s blessing,

May he be the favorite of his brothers,
May he dip his

foot in oil.

is none like God,

God is a refuge,
A support are the arms everlasting.
He drove out the enemy before you
By

Thus Israel dwells in safety,
Untroubled is Jacob’s abode,*abode Others “fountain.”

In a land of grain and wine,
Under heavens dripping dew.
O happy Israel!

Your protecting Shield,

your Sword triumphant!

text: מִצְרָ֑יִם לְפַרְעֹ֥ה וּלְכׇל־עֲבָדָ֖יו וּלְכׇל־אַרְצֽוֹ׃ וּלְכֹל֙
translation: against Pharaoh and all his courtiers and his whole country, and for

text: הַיָּ֣ד הַחֲזָקָ֔ה וּלְכֹ֖ל הַמּוֹרָ֣א הַגָּד֑וֹל אֲשֶׁר֙ עָשָׂ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה
translation: all the great might and awesome power that Moses displayed
parts: הַיָּ֣ד הַחֲזָקָ֔ה וּלְכֹ֖ל הַמּוֹרָ֣א הַגָּד֑וֹל אֲשֶׁר֙ עָשָׂ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה

text: לְעֵינֵ֖י כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
translation: before all Israel.
